title: When the Quran Quotes the Wealthy, They Argue Theology
excerpt: The Quran preserves four arguments made by people with money about money — and every one of them is a claim about God. He would have fed him if He wanted. He gave us this because He approves. Prayer has no jurisdiction over our accounts. Revelation should have gone to a richer man.
seo_title: The Rich Man's Theology: Four Arguments the Quran Records (36:47, 34:35, 11:87, 43:31)
seo_description: Ya-Sin, Saba, Hud and Az-Zukhruf record what wealthy objectors actually said — always a true premise about God aimed at an obligation. With Ibn Kathir, al-Tabari, al-Muyassar and al-Jalalayn.
